name: JAGENT NFT
description: JAGENT NFT for Binance Agent ID holders on BNB Smart Chain. Phase 1 NFT mint. Phase 2: the JAGENT token will be distributed by snapshot of NFT holders - free-minted NFTs are planned to carry 15,000,000 JAGENT each at the snapshot; paid-minted NFTs carry by batch: 50,000,000 JAGENT each in batch 1, decreasing 5% (2,500,000) per batch to 15,000,000 in batch 15.

attributes.value: 15,000,000 (free mint) / 50,000,000 down to 15,000,000 by batch (paid mint) JAGENT per NFT (snapshot)
